Press **Validate answers** to inspect each parsed response, then **Check answer** to grade it. An edit requires validation again.

## Equivalent rational expression

The prompt states the domain (x\ne -n). A cancelled fraction and the original unreduced expression both receive full credit because the question asks for *any equivalent expression* on that domain. A reciprocal triggers a targeted feedback branch.

```{.stack-question}
#| file: questions/rational-equivalence.xml
#| question: Equivalent rational expression
#| variants: 3
#| seed: 29
#| review: true
```

[Download the rational question](questions/rational-equivalence.xml)

## Three numerical checks

These fields demonstrate absolute tolerance, relative tolerance, and decimal-place precision. The final field distinguishes `17.5` from `17.50`, because the written precision is part of the task. Their response trees contribute 30%, 40%, and 30% of the total.

```{.stack-question}
#| file: questions/numerical-measurement.xml
#| question: Rectangle and triangle measurements
#| seed: 47
#| review: true
```

[Download the numerical question](questions/numerical-measurement.xml)

## Imported STACK fixture

This original Moodle export illustrates the form-sensitive `EqualComAss` test in an established STACK question. Its qtests are retained in the unmodified XML. The local adapter reports a build-time error when a question relies on an unsupported feature.

```{.stack-question}
#| file: questions/upstream/algmap-6-1.xml
#| question: AlgMap-6.1
#| variants: 2
#| seed: 17
#| review: true
```
